subject: economics
topic: Basic tools: tables, graphs and measures of central tendency

kept.q: The ages (in years) of 5 pupils in a Lagos primary school club are: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. What is the mean age of the pupils?
kept.explanation: Mean = sum of values divided by number of values. Sum = 4+6+8+10+12 = 40, and 40 divided by 5 = 8.
kept.pidgin: Mean na when you add all the numbers togeda den divide by how many dem be. 4+6+8+10+12 give 40, 40 divide by 5 na 8.

kept.q: In statistics, which measure of central tendency is defined as the value that occurs most frequently in a set of data?
kept.explanation: The mode is the value that appears most often in a data set. The mean is the average, the median is the middle value, and the range measures spread, not central tendency.
kept.pidgin: Mode na di value wey dey show pass for inside data. Mean na average, median na di middle number, range na di spread, dem no be mode.

kept.q: A table shows the prices of goods at Oja Oba market in one morning: Yam costs ₦500, Rice costs ₦700, Beans costs ₦600, Garri costs ₦300, and Maize costs ₦400. Based on this table, which commodity has the highest price?
kept.explanation: Comparing the prices listed, Rice at ₦700 is higher than Yam (₦500), Beans (₦600), Garri (₦300) and Maize (₦400). So Rice has the highest price.
kept.pidgin: If you compare di prices for di table, Rice na ₦700, e pass Yam (₦500), Beans (₦600), Garri (₦300) and Maize (₦400). So Rice get di highest price.

kept.q: In a test, the scores of 10 students and their frequencies are: score 3 (2 students), score 5 (3 students), score 7 (4 students), score 9 (1 student). What is the mean score?
kept.explanation: Multiply each score by its frequency and add: (3x2)+(5x3)+(7x4)+(9x1) = 6+15+28+9 = 58. Divide by total number of students, 10, to get 58/10 = 5.8.
kept.pidgin: Multiply each score by im frequency den add dem: (3x2)+(5x3)+(7x4)+(9x1) = 6+15+28+9 = 58. Divide 58 by 10 students, you go get 5.8.

q.q: A trader recorded her daily sales (in ₦'000) for one week as: 3, 9, 5, 7, 11, 2, 8. What is the median of this data?
q.explanation: Arrange the numbers in order: 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 11. With 7 values, the median is the 4th value, which is 7.
q.pidgin: First arrange di numbers well well: 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 11. Since na 7 numbers, di middle one (4th position) na 7, so dat na di median.

q.q: The ages of students in an SS3 class, with their frequencies, are given as: 14 years (5 students), 15 years (8 students), 16 years (6 students), 17 years (1 student). What is the modal age?
q.explanation: The mode is the value with the highest frequency. Age 15 has 8 students, which is more than any other age group, so 15 is the mode.
q.pidgin: Mode na di age wey get di most students. 15 years get 8 students, e pass every oda age group, so 15 be di mode.

q.q: The weights (in kg) of 8 bags of rice measured by a trader are: 12, 15, 11, 18, 14, 16, 13, 17. What is the median weight?
q.explanation: Arrange in order: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18. With 8 values (an even number), the median is the average of the 4th and 5th values: (14+15)/2 = 14.5.
q.pidgin: Arrange di numbers well: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18. Since na 8 numbers (even number), median na di average of di 4th and 5th number: (14+15)/2 = 14.5.
